basic_info.description: This beautiful bay view home has been thoughtfully updated for modern living while retaining its wonderful period details.    Ideally-configured for entertaining, the main level boasts an expansive living room, formal dining room, and spacious chef's kitchen  appointed with stainless steel appliances, Caesarstone counters and abundant cabinetry.    The bright living room and formal dining room have soaring ceilings, convenient built-ins, well-kept hardwood floors and a cozy fireplace. The main level is completed by a full bath, convenient office nook and lovely outlooks to the manicured garden.     The home's upper level offers a primary bedroom with captivating bay views and a guest bedroom. A sunny full bath has the comfort of a heated tiled floor.    Ideal for working from home, a bright office on the lower level opens onto a sunny deck and  beautifully-landscaped garden planted with fragrant roses and a lemon tree.     The home's central air conditioning makes even Bernal's sunniest days  comfortable!    This lovely home is completed by a spacious garage with laundry area, a well-equipped workshop and abundant storage.     On a tranquil block very near the shops and restaurants of Cortland Street, this home  is a must-see!
